column7: MERGE-FIX-3482K (ask 3482-mixed-update-role-share (a)): UpdateRole and UpdateSharePermission failed closed as a whole on a mixed update (removes AND adds permissions; a lower permission AND a later expiry, or the reverse), so an audit outage rolled the revocation back, and wrote the rows of a narrowing or neutral update best-effort after the commit. A mixed update is now two commits, narrowing first (owed) and the rest fail closed; a narrowing or neutral one is owed; a widening one stays fail closed. This test and TestSecurityMutationAudit_UpdateSharePermission_ByDirection read the database under a total outage: narrowing/neutral rows queued, widening refused with nothing applied, mixed refused with PartialMutationError and the narrowing alone applied; TestMixedRequestSplit_NarrowingNeverBlockedRemainderFailsClosed runs the full split matrix on both ops (SQLite and PostgreSQL). Red on eb2110e60 (production files of main, tests of the PR): every narrow, no-op and mixed case of both ops, and 14 of 16 split-matrix cases.
